title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I am an unmarried sister who tries hard to adhere to Islamic teachings. 1. Many times I get dreams of myself urinating in my dream . Seeing mother in dream 16608 views Q. دس سال پہلے میں مسلمان ہواتھا، میرے والدین کا انتقال ہوگیاہے، میرے دوست کے والدین ہی میرا خیال رکھتے تھے، وہ لوگ میرے لیے دلہن تلاش کررہے ہیں، میرے مسلمان ہونے کی وجہ سے بہت ساری لڑکیوں نے مجھے مسترد کردیاہے،میں ان پر الزام نہیں دے رہاہوں، بلکہ مجھے اتفاق ہے کہ ہر ایک کو اپنا شریک حیات چننے کا حق ہے، لیکن میری صورت حال میں سبھی لوگ ایک ہی وجہ بتاتے ہیں۔ ایک اور بات میں شیئر کرنا چاہوں گاکہ پوری دنیا میں اسلام بہت تیزی سے پھیل رہا ہے، ( اللہ کا شکرہے)۔حال ہی میں بی بی سی /سی این این (یقین نہیں ہے، بلکہ سناہے)نے اسلام کا سروے کیا تو اسلام ہی ایک ایسا مذہب ہے جو ہر سال تیزی سے پھیل رہا ہے۔ الحمد للہ۔ میں صرف یہ وجہ جاننا چاہتاہوں کہ کیوں لوگ سمجھتے ہیں کہ سارے نومسلم گناہ گار ہیں؟ اور ان کو مسترد کیا جاتاہے؟ میرا خیال ہے کہ حضرت محمد صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کے علاوہ سبھی لوگ نومسلم ہیں اور اسلام میں داخل ہوئے ہیں؟اگر میں غلط کہہ رہا ہوں تو صحیح رہنمائی فرمائیں۔ 1337 views Q. The Buzareg called my fiancee and told her why are you doing like this? He did not mention what she did wrong. After that he told her that Hazoor Saw is angry with you. Now I am worried about this dream. Please tell me the tabeer of this dream. She saw this dream few days back. We have not yet done Nikah & are engaged (Mangni). May Almighty Allah gives you reward in this world and the hereafter Aameen. 1721 views Q. MY BROTHER IS BORN AS A HANDICAP.HE DONT HAVE MAN HOOD IMEAN AS A HIJDA HE BORN. 1419 views Q. As Salam Alay kum i have deen dreem after asar i came from office after doing night shift i saw in the dream that some arabs changing the Kiswa of Kabah Shareef and i was also helping them in changing Kiswa and ..i internally thinking after changing Kiswa i will ask some cloth of Old kiswa to make cap and i asked them they agree to give and i saw apeace of cloth with me and then i woke up 1419 views Q. - DREAM - I had this dream long ago. I have 4 brothers and 1 sister. I dreamnt that we were living in a lone house, in the middle of a desert. Our car was parked some way away from the house. One night (in the dream) I went to the car and started the ignition. But instead of going forward the car raised up into the air. It kept rising up and reached a most beatiful place with abundant greenry, trees and breathtaking scenery. The grass was of a very rich colour and I remember a stream flowing some way away. I have not seen a place so beautiful in my lifetime. I heard my brothers calling from down below .. they said that "Mum is calling you" .. but I was so immersed in the beauty of the place that I refused to go back down. The scene changed: I was down again. It was another night and I went to the car again. I started the ignition again. The car rose but but was stopped 5-6 feet into the air.. My brothers had tied a rope to the back of the car and now they started pulling me back. i remember insisting on going up but they brought me down. I was really sad. I kept thinking about the place. On the 7th day after I had gone to the beautiful place, I looked at the moon and found a face on it. I was about 8-10 years old when I saw this dream. Now I'm almost 19. I have changed recently and now pray 5 times, sometimes Tahajjud, Ishraq, Awwabein too etc. 1357 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 165941 Country: India Title: Dream of Marriage and Death: What Could It Mean? Question: I saw a dream which I don’t remember fully, but I saw marriage happening and also someone died or someone wants to kill someone in that marriage what is the meaning of this. Answer ID: 165941 Posted on: Feb 26, 2025 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 85/39/SN=03/1440) All these seem to be disturbed thoughts, don’t worry about them. Make wudhu and read mu’awazatain (Surah Falaq and Surah Naas) and Ayatul Kursi before going to bed and blow over your body. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
